title: Thanks for your purchase | Didim Labs

props.title: Thanks, it's yours
props.lead: If you bought it from Soju, go back to Soju. It installs the game by itself as soon as the payment clears, usually within a minute.

props.text: Your license key is in the receipt email from Polar. In Soju, open **Didim Labs Store**, press **I have a key** and paste it. The Windows download is linked in the same email.
소주에서 사셨다면 소주로 돌아가세요. 결제가 끝나면 1분 안에 알아서 설치됩니다. 웹사이트에서 사셨다면 Polar 영수증 메일에 있는 라이선스 키를 소주의 **Didim Labs Store → I have a key**에 붙여 넣으세요.
Lost the email? Sign in at [polar.sh/didim-labs/portal](https://polar.sh/didim-labs/portal) with your purchase email to see your key and downloads.
